title: A subgroup containing minus identity admits representatives modulo sign
statement: Let G = SL₂(ℤ), and let Δ ≤ G contain −I. For γ : Δ write γ̄ for its underlying element of G. There exists L ⊆ Δ such that every δ : Δ has a representative γ ∈ L with γ̄ = δ̄ or γ̄ = −δ̄, and whenever γ,η ∈ L satisfy γ̄ = η̄ or γ̄ = −η̄, one has γ = η as elements of Δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)), (-1 : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∈ Δ → ∃ L : Set Δ, (∀ δ : Δ, ∃ γ : Δ, γ ∈ L ∧ ((γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = (δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∨ (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = -(δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ))) ∧ (∀ γ : Δ, γ ∈ L → ∀ η : Δ, η ∈ L → ((γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = (η : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∨ (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = -(η : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) → γ = η)
